note: Gibraltar: the Department of Employment asks a work permit, requested by the employer for a specific post for up to 12 months before the work begins, for anyone not entitled to work there, such as non-EEA nationals; Swiss nationals need none (so EEA and Swiss nationals keep the eea list's right). British citizens are of Gibraltar's own nationality. Every engagement is registered (a Notice of Terms of Engagement for all workers), and no days of work without the permit are named.

sources.title: HM Government of Gibraltar, Department of Employment: Employment Service Registration Explained
sources.said: Persons who are not entitled to work in Gibraltar (e.g. non-EEA nationals, see notes below) will require an employer to request a Work Permit before commencement of employment. A work permit is issued to an employer for a specific post and for a period not exceeding 12 months. ... (Note: Swiss nationals do not require a work permit to work in Gibraltar)
